headline: Raleigh DC go-live has slipped 21 days to 1 February 2027, creating risk of collision with spring inventory count; a hard no-go decision is required by 15 January 2027 to avoid April fallback.
summary: Raleigh DC go-live has slipped 21 days to 1 February 2027, creating risk of collision with spring inventory count; a hard no-go decision is required by 15 January 2027 to avoid April fallback. High-impact risk Handheld scanner firmware certification has no owner and mitigation. The budget forecast is $1,284,000 against a $1,200,000 plan (+7.0%), and 1 change request awaits approval (CR-14 returns processing module).

conditional_risks.label: Peak season collision
conditional_risks.condition: only if go-live slips past February; the current forecast is 1 February 2027, so it hasn't happened
